brief:
Three years before the Al-Aqsa Flood operation began, Gaza was sinking into a sea of living misery, according to Shehab Wire. Those who had been crying out day and night for basic survival and protesting Gaza's dire conditions understood the scale of the catastrophe.

The operation, which marked a turning point in the conflict, occurred against a backdrop of deteriorating humanitarian circumstances that had long characterized the territory.

title: Gaza drowning in humanitarian crisis before Al-Aqsa Flood operation
